title: Orca putting the terminal in another worktree than the one a path: selector names is refused
source: intended: TS-ODDITIES L4 (owner decision, defect N-22): the folder Orca reports is checked on every launch
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES L4, owner decision, defect N-22). When --worktree names a path, the folder Orca reports must be that same worktree: the primary is a worktree of the repo but not the one asked for, so the launch exits 2 with the 'asked for' text, closes the terminal and writes no registry line. The TS binary compares nothing without a dialog and launches (exit 0).

stderr.contains: JITSO REJECTED: untrusted folder {{PROJECT}}: --worktree asked for {{WORKTREE_linked}}; the terminal was closed
